infoLinks.urlText: Buses replace trains between Central and Bondi Junction. Trains do not stop at Wolli Creek
infoLinks.content:
Wednesday 5 and Thursday 6 August
  • Nightly from 9.50pm to 1.30am, buses replace trains between Central and Bondi Junction, but do not stop at Martin Place.
  • Most trains run to a changed timetable between Cronulla, Waterfall and the City Circle, with some making extra stops at St Peters and Erskineville.

    - Sydenham or Central for metro services to Martin Place
    - Central for buses to Kings Cross and Edgecliff
    - Town Hall for express buses to Bondi Junction.

  • Buses run between Sydenham, Wolli Creek and Arncliffe.

infoLinks.content:
Sunday 2 August   
  • From 1pm to 4pm, trains do not stop at Wolli Creek but make an extra stop at Arncliffe.
  • Buses run between Sydenham, Wolli Creek and Arncliffe.
  • Change at Arncliffe or Sydenham for a bus to Wolli Creek or change at Central for a T8 Airport train if you have luggage or accessibility needs.

  • Plan your trip before you travel for up-to-date real time information. You can also subscribe to planned trackwork alerts.
Bus route
36T4 Arncliffe, Wolli Creek, Sydenham and return
 
Replacement buses
  • Most replacement buses are Opal-enabled. Tap on and off with a valid Opal or contactless card. Fines apply without a valid ticket.
  • Bikes aren’t allowed on replacement buses. Use a nearby bike shed or locker.
  • Services may be delayed or cancelled due to driver shortages. We're working to minimise disruptions and keep your journey safe.
